instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot, eye-level. In an indoor martial arts studio, the man in the white gi (R1) on the left is kneeling on both knees, leaning forward. The man in the gray gi (R2) on the right is kneeling on one knee, leaning forward. They are locked in a close head-to-head clinch, holding each other's necks on a black mat under warm indoor lighting.
